channel.title: Bloomfield at Home pins
channel.description: Honest guides to living well at home in later life

item.title: Personal alarms explained: how to choose one
item.description: Thinking about a personal alarm for mum or dad? How monitored alarms and falls detectors work, the council lifeline option, and 6 questions to ask any provider before you sign up.

item.title: Room-by-room falls prevention checklist
item.description: Simple, low-cost changes that make an older person's home safer, room by room - plus the free council occupational therapy assessment many families don't know about.

item.title: Stairlift, homelift or living downstairs?
item.description: Stairs getting difficult? The pros and cons of a stairlift, a through-floor homelift or moving the bedroom downstairs, and the grant that can help with the cost.

item.title: Lasting Power of Attorney explained simply
item.description: What an LPA is, the two types, why to sort it before it's needed, and how to make one yourself using the official gov.uk service.

item.title: 15 everyday aids that make life at home easier
item.description: Small, inexpensive aids for the kitchen, bathroom and living room that help older people stay independent at home.

item.title: Help with household bills most pensioners miss
item.description: The Warm Home Discount, broadband social tariffs, the free Priority Services Register and other help with bills for older households in the UK.

item.title: Bath, shower and toilet aids explained
item.description: Bath boards, shower stools, raised toilet seats and grab rails - what each one is for, what to measure before buying, and the free council occupational therapy assessment to ask for first. Contains affiliate links.
